name: claude-octopus
description: Multi-LLM orchestration with Double Diamond workflows, provider routing, safety gates, and automation. Dispatches to Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Qwen, Perplexity, OpenRouter, Ollama, and OpenCode from a single plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-LLM orchestration with Codex-native subagents when available.
interface.longDescription: Claude Octopus orchestrates multiple AI providers (Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Qwen, Perplexity, OpenRouter, Ollama, OpenCode) through structured Double Diamond workflows. For Codex, the plugin surfaces generated .codex skills plus project-scoped .codex agents so native subagents can be used directly in host sessions, while shell-driven dispatch keeps a safe bridge fallback for external CLI execution.
defaultPrompt: Build a feature with native Codex subagents
Review this code with adversarial multi-provider analysis
